GlobalVariables.StudyDescription: Compiled GFlow study design for NCT01631552 Benchmark.

Decode.TranslatedText: Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander

CodeListDef.Name: Action Taken with Study Treatment Codelist

Decode.TranslatedText: 0 - Fully active, able to carry on all pre-disease performance without restriction
1 - Restricted in physically strenuous activity but ambulatory and able to carry out light work
2 - Ambulatory and capable of all selfcare but unable to carry out any work activities
3 - Capable of only limited selfcare; confined to bed or chair >50% of waking hours
4 - Completely disabled; cannot carry on any selfcare

Description.TranslatedText: Mosteller formula: sqrt((HEIGHT * WEIGHT) / 3600)

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Baseline demographic data summaries will include age, age group, sex, race, ethnicity, height, weight, body mass index (BMI), and number of subjects with renal impairment and hepatic impairment.

Description.TranslatedText: BMI formula: WEIGHT / ((HEIGHT / 100) ^ 2)

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Body mass index will be calculated as: BMI (kg/m 2 ) = weight in kg / (height in m 2 ).

Description.TranslatedText: ANC calculation: WBC * (NEUT / 100)

makoto:SourceGrounding.ProtocolSection: Section 7.1. Adverse Events & Laboratory Safety Evaluation
makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: | Preferred term: vomiting | | Neutropenia+ | Preferred terms: neutropenia, neutrophil count decreased, febrile neutropenia | | Febrile neutropenia+ | Preferred term: febrile neutropenia

Description.TranslatedText: Identification of severe or life-threatening infusion reactions based on NCI toxicity grading.

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: For a serious infusion reaction considered severe or life threatening (NCI toxicity Grade 3 or higher) an infusion must be permanently terminated.

MethodDef.Name: Body Surface Area (BSA — DuBois & DuBois Formula)

Description.TranslatedText: Body Surface Area (BSA, m^2) via DuBois & DuBois allometric equation: 0.007184 * (WEIGHT^0.425) * (HEIGHT^0.725).

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Body Surface Area (BSA — DuBois & DuBois Formula) synthesized from protocol assessment 'Height'.

Description.TranslatedText: Ideal Body Weight (IBW, kg) via Devine formula for sex-stratified height above 152.4 cm (60 inches).

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Ideal Body Weight (IBW — Devine Formula) synthesized from protocol assessment 'Height'.

MethodDef.Name: Adjusted Body Weight (ABW — Obesity Dosing Cap)

Description.TranslatedText: Adjusted Body Weight (ABW, kg) for obese subjects (WEIGHT > 1.2 * IBW): IBW + 0.4 * (WEIGHT - IBW).

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Adjusted Body Weight (ABW — Obesity Dosing Cap) synthesized from protocol assessment 'Height'.

MethodDef.Name: Fridericia Rate-Corrected QT Interval (QTcF — ICH E14)

Description.TranslatedText: ICH E14 Fridericia rate-corrected QT interval (QTcF, ms): QT * (60 / EGHR)^(1/3).

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Fridericia Rate-Corrected QT Interval (QTcF — ICH E14) synthesized from protocol assessment '12-Lead ECG'.

MethodDef.Name: Bazett Rate-Corrected QT Interval (QTcB — ICH E14)

Description.TranslatedText: ICH E14 Bazett rate-corrected QT interval (QTcB, ms): QT * (60 / EGHR)^(1/2).

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Bazett Rate-Corrected QT Interval (QTcB — ICH E14) synthesized from protocol assessment '12-Lead ECG'.

MethodDef.Name: Longitudinal Change from Baseline in QTcF (Delta-QTcF — ICH E14)

Description.TranslatedText: ICH E14 longitudinal change from baseline in Fridericia-corrected QT interval (Delta-QTcF, ms) for >30 ms and >60 ms outlier flagging.

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Longitudinal Change from Baseline in QTcF (Delta-QTcF — ICH E14) synthesized from protocol assessment '12-Lead ECG'.

MethodDef.Name: Creatinine Clearance (Cockcroft-Gault CrCl)

Description.TranslatedText: Cockcroft-Gault Creatinine Clearance (CrCl, mL/min) for renal dosing adjustment based on age, weight, serum creatinine, and sex.

MethodDef.FormalExpression: round(((140 - ITEM.AGE) * ITEM.WEIGHT) / (72.0 * ITEM.CREAT) * (0.85 if ITEM.SEX == 'F' else 1.0), 1)

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: adequate renal (creatinine ≤2.0 x IULN)

MethodDef.Name: Estimated GFR (CKD-EPI 2021 Race-Free Equation)

Description.TranslatedText: 2021 CKD-EPI race-free estimated Glomerular Filtration Rate (eGFR, mL/min/1.73m^2) derived from serum creatinine, age, and sex.

MethodDef.FormalExpression: round(142 * (min(ITEM.CREAT / (0.7 if ITEM.SEX == 'F' else 0.9), 1.0) ** (-0.241 if ITEM.SEX == 'F' else -0.302)) * (max(ITEM.CREAT / (0.7 if ITEM.SEX == 'F' else 0.9), 1.0) ** -1.200) * (0.9938 ** ITEM.AGE) * (1.012 if ITEM.SEX == 'F' else 1.0), 1)

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: adequate renal (creatinine ≤2.0 x IULN)

MethodDef.Name: Blood Urea Nitrogen to Creatinine Ratio (BUN/Cr)

Description.TranslatedText: Blood Urea Nitrogen to Serum Creatinine ratio (BUN/Cr) for pre-renal azotemia and dehydration screening.

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: adequate renal (creatinine ≤2.0 x IULN)

Description.TranslatedText: Absolute Lymphocyte Count (ALC, 10^9/L) derived from total white blood cell count and lymphocyte percentage: WBC * (LYM / 100).

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Routine safety laboratories, based on hematology and serum chemistry data, will be listed by patient and summarized by descriptive statistics for each dose group, if appropriate.

Description.TranslatedText: Neutrophil-to-Lymphocyte Ratio (NLR) prognostic inflammatory biomarker derived as ANC divided by ALC.

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Routine safety laboratories, based on hematology and serum chemistry data, will be listed by patient and summarized by descriptive statistics for each dose group, if appropriate.

MethodDef.Name: Hepatic Enzyme / Bilirubin Upper Limit of Normal Ratio (x ULN)

Description.TranslatedText: Hepatic transaminase Upper Limit of Normal multiple (ALT / ALT_ULN) for NCI-CTCAE hepatotoxicity grading.

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: hepatic function (bilirubin ≤1.5 x IULN

Description.TranslatedText: De Ritis ratio of Aspartate Aminotransferase (AST) to Alanine Aminotransferase (ALT) for hepatocellular injury differentiation.

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: AST and ALT ≤ 3 x IULN or 5 x IULN

MethodDef.Name: Total Bilirubin Upper Limit of Normal Multiple (TBILI x ULN)

Description.TranslatedText: Total Bilirubin Upper Limit of Normal multiple (TBILI / TBILI_ULN) for NCI-CTCAE hyperbilirubinemia grading and Hy's Law evaluation.

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: hepatic function (bilirubin ≤1.5 x IULN

MethodDef.Name: FDA Drug-Induced Liver Injury (Hy's Law) Composite Flag

Description.TranslatedText: FDA DILI Guidance composite Hy's Law biochemical criterion: (ALT >= 3x ULN or AST >= 3x ULN) and Total Bilirubin >= 2x ULN.

MethodDef.FormalExpression: 1 if ((ITEM.ALT / ITEM.ALT_ULN >= 3.0 or ITEM.AST / ITEM.AST_ULN >= 3.0) and (ITEM.TBILI / ITEM.TBILI_ULN >= 2.0)) else 0

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: hepatic function (bilirubin ≤1.5 x IULN

Description.TranslatedText: Payne albumin-corrected serum calcium (mg/dL): CALCIUM + 0.8 * (4.0 - ALB).

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Routine safety laboratories, based on hematology and serum chemistry data, will be listed by patient and summarized by descriptive statistics for each dose group, if appropriate.

Description.TranslatedText: Serum Anion Gap (mmol/L) for metabolic acidosis evaluation: SODIUM - (CHLORIDE + BICARB).

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Routine safety laboratories, based on hematology and serum chemistry data, will be listed by patient and summarized by descriptive statistics for each dose group, if appropriate.

Description.TranslatedText: Non-invasive FIB-4 hepatic fibrosis index derived from Age, AST, Platelets, and ALT: (AGE * AST) / (PLT * sqrt(ALT)).

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: AST and ALT ≤ 3 x IULN or 5 x IULN

MethodDef.Name: Protocol Weight / BSA-Adjusted Planned Dose Calculation

Description.TranslatedText: Protocol-prescribed weight-based (mg/kg) or BSA-based (mg/m^2) target dose calculation prior to drug preparation.

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Treatment delay for any reason > 3 weeks (Treatment delays of up to 3 weeks will be allowed at the investigator's discretion)

Description.TranslatedText: Relative Dose Intensity (RDI, %) calculated as actual administered dose divided by protocol-planned dose.

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Treatment delay for any reason > 3 weeks (Treatment delays of up to 3 weeks will be allowed at the investigator's discretion)

Description.TranslatedText: Cumulative administered study drug dose across all completed treatment cycles.

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Treatment delay for any reason > 3 weeks (Treatment delays of up to 3 weeks will be allowed at the investigator's discretion)

Description.TranslatedText: Treatment compliance percentage derived from total doses administered/taken divided by planned doses over the treatment period.

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Treatment delay for any reason > 3 weeks (Treatment delays of up to 3 weeks will be allowed at the investigator's discretion)

Description.TranslatedText: CDISC ADaM ADAE adverse event duration (AEDUR, days) from onset date (AESTDAT) to resolution date (AEENDAT) inclusive.

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: NCI CTCAE v4.0 is used to grade all adverse events and to provide dose reduction, delay or cessation guidelines in the event of treatment-related toxicity

Description.TranslatedText: CDISC ADaM ADSL Total Treatment Duration in days: (TRTEDT - TRTSDT) + 1.

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: Any variance between the calculated dose and the actual administered dose must be documented in source documents and Case Report Forms (CRFs)

MethodDef.Name: ADaM Longitudinal Change & Percent Change from Baseline (CHG / PCHG)

Description.TranslatedText: CDISC ADaM longitudinal Change from Baseline (CHG = AVAL - BASE) and Percent Change from Baseline (PCHG = 100 * (AVAL - BASE) / BASE).

makoto:SourceGrounding.makoto:SourceQuote: ADaM Longitudinal Change & Percent Change from Baseline (CHG / PCHG) synthesized from protocol assessment 'Weight'.
